cli.intro: OpenWord — create, inspect and export documents on one native model.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.create: Create a document and save it to a project file
cmd.open: Open a document and print its committed revision and structure
cmd.save: Save an open document to a project file
cmd.inspect: Run structure and style checks on a document
cmd.find: Search a document and print match positions
cmd.stats: Print block, heading, table, word and reading-time counts
cmd.outline: Print the nested heading outline with levels and block positions
cmd.edit: Apply atomic edits and print the new revision
cmd.replace: Replace text in a document and print the replacement count
cmd.template: Fill {{key}} placeholders from a JSON object and save the result
cmd.undo: Undo recent edits in a document (saved back only for .oword)
cmd.redo: Redo undone edits in a document (saved back only for .oword)
cmd.merge: Append another document's blocks to a document
cmd.export: Write one export target from a document

opt.title: Document title
opt.overwrite: Replace the output file when it already exists
opt.checks: Comma-separated checks: styles, fonts, images, sections, tables, links
opt.format: Export target: docx, dotx, pdf, html, md, txt or rtf
opt.paragraph: Append a paragraph with this text
opt.heading: Append a section heading with this text
opt.bullet: Append an unordered list item (repeat the option to add more)
opt.numbered: Append an ordered list item (repeat the option to add more)
opt.numberedStart: First number of the appended ordered list (default 1)
opt.quote: Append a block quote with this text
opt.code: Append a fenced code block with this text
opt.codeLang: Language tag for the code block, such as rust
opt.table: Append a table from a JSON array of string rows
opt.duplicateBlock: Deep-copy a block and its children, inserting the copy right after it by block id such as node-3
opt.author: Document author
opt.expectedRevision: Reject the edit unless the document is at this revision
opt.limit: Maximum number of matches to return
opt.steps: Number of edits to undo or redo (default 1)
opt.ignoreCase: Match text without regard to case
opt.wholeWord: Replace only matches with no word character on either side
opt.values: JSON object of placeholder values, such as {"name":"Ada"}
